name: Summer Music Clinic: Senior Session
what_you_do: A week on campus. You play in band, choir, orchestra and jazz groups. You take instrument and voice classes, composing and music tech. You also hear guest concerts.
who_can_apply: Students who are finishing grades 9 to 12. Some courses need a placement audition or a talk with staff.
pay_detail: Residential $1,275; daily commuter $875; Violin or Saxophone Institute $1,500; plus a $75 nonrefundable registration fee. Financial aid is available.
deadline_text: 2027 registration opens Jan 12, 2027 and closes May 15, 2027.
notes: The Violin and Saxophone Institutes need a recorded tryout. It is due April 1.
